feeding_claim.verbatim: A commitment to 100% grass-fed and finished ruminants defines our approach.

notes: Family farm on Kings Corners Road at Romulus in the Finger Lakes. Checked the homepage, farming practices page, questions and answers page, on farm store page and pickup locations page. The farming practices page says ruminants are 100% grass-fed and finished with rotational grazing; pigs and chickens forage on pasture and get locally sourced non-GMO grain. On-farm store open Friday 11 to 5 and Saturday 9 to 4 (holiday hours posted for November 2026), an on-farm butcher shop for pickup orders, online ordering, and home delivery to doorsteps across New York State, which is recorded as shipping to NY; the Verifier may decide whether local-delivery fits better. The pickup locations page lists none. No bulk shares, farmers markets or products from other farms mentioned. The site also has a wholesale page. Old Ford Farm's store (already listed) resells this farm's beef.
